entries.zh: 阁老；内阁大学士（明代辅政重臣，西人比作王家议事会之长）
entries.en: grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat, senior minister of state; rendered as 'president of the Royal Council'

entries.zh: 都察院；明代最高监察官署，统辖十三道监察御史（西译作'十三道巡察御史'之首署）
entries.en: the Censorate, imperial office of surveillance presiding over the thirteen circuits of inspecting censors

entries.zh: 都御史；都察院长官，总领十三道御史
entries.en: chief censor, head of the Censorate

entries.zh: 囹圄；监狱，牢狱（preso 于此条兼指系狱、入狱）
entries.en: prison, jail (the Sangley column itself glosses it 'carcel'); to be imprisoned

entries.zh: 禁囚；因罪收禁之囚，囚于刑狱者
entries.en: prisoner confined in the criminal jail

entries.zh: 囚罪；因罪系狱（西注谓犯死罪而囚）
entries.en: imprisoned for a capital offense; the crime for which one is jailed

entries.zh: 囚头；囚犯之首，狱中领班之囚
entries.en: chief prisoner, head among the inmates
entries.notes: 西注 'pide la pa(?)entes' 残损难辨，仅据汉字'囚頭'与音写'fiu tau'定释。

entries.zh: 借；借取、借入（兼指贷出、放借）
entries.en: to borrow; to lend, loan (prestar/restar in the lending sense)

entries.zh: 拨；拨付银钱，拨给（以为借贷）
entries.notes: 音写 'poa ya po pobin zo' 多字污损难辨（仅首音节有声调号），据汉字'撥'与西注 'prestar' 定释。

entries.en: to lend, loan; to give credit

entries.zh: 代借；代人借取，替人作借
entries.en: to borrow on another's behalf; the Spanish column reads 'restar por oro', perhaps for 'por otro'
entries.notes: 西注 'restar por oro' 与汉字'代借'未能完全对应，疑 'oro' 为 'otro'（替人）之讹。

entries.zh: 借煮；借物炊煮（借来煮食）
entries.en: to borrow a thing to cook with; to lend an article (coisa)
entries.notes: 西注 'restar eng coisa' 残损难解，与汉字'借煮'对应欠明。

entries.en: to borrow in hardship or necessity; to borrow wherever one can
entries.notes: 音写尾段 'engdzamir' 污损难辨；'困'或为'睏'（借宿）之俗写，未能定夺，故降置信。

entries.zh: 仁义财；以仁义为凭的借贷（凭德信放贷，不专为利）
entries.en: wealth lent out of benevolence and righteousness; to lend trusting another's virtue (fiar en su virtud)

entries.notes: 汉字'提'与音写 'ua gin'（gin＝银）虽可辨，但西注 'P restar~ conpustica' 残损、汉字与音写对应不明，材料不足，仅存疑。
